text:
Rina: Kickoff for an ISV onboarding playbook for the LangChain/LlamaIndex gateway adapter. Goal: marketplace-ready by next Tues.
Vik: High level: sample app, docker image, terraform routing example, perf matrix, and a short SI runbook.
Sam: For perf, we need baseline numbers on tail latency for 1..12 concurrent streams. I can run microbenchmarks but need the test harness.
Priya: I'll own the sample app and the migration snippet that shows session propagation. Keep it tiny, copy-paste friendly.
eng-qa: We'll add a CI gate that fails if tail latency > 200ms p95 for streaming<=4, and >500ms p95 for streaming>8. Where do we put the CSV results?
Rina: s3://redwood-partners/onboarding/gateway-adapter/2005554321. Add a README with steps to reproduce.
Vik: Legal/marketing notes: avoid "certified" language. Marketplace wants a 40-word blurb + 1-line installer command.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: include screenshot (800x450) and 512px logo. Use marketplace asset checklist.
Sam: Noted. Also hardware note: recommend A100-v3 or H100 for high concurrency; call out T4 as limited.
Priya: Drafting sample snippet now. Example header copy: \n```\n# middleware to copy x-session-id to routing header\nif 'x-session-id' in req.headers:\n    req.headers['x-routing-key'] = req.headers['x-session-id']\n```\nRina: Action items: Priya sample app + snippet, Sam perf runs + CSV, Vik marketplace blurb, eng-qa CI gate. Review sync Fri 11am PT. Keep messages short in the final doc. Thanks :rocket:
